title: Reconcile the market by noon
brief: Every Saturday I track stall fees and day tallies on paper slips that blow away before reconciliation.

target_population.role: market-day manager coordinating twenty fictional stalls at a weekly farmers market
target_population.coverage_limit: one market day and one fee schedule; fee records only, never payment processing

core_task.summary: record a stall's fee as collected and watch the day tally reconcile
core_task.success_oracle: marking stall 7 as fee-recorded moves it from the outstanding column to reconciled and raises the day tally by exactly 35

not_applicable_states.loading: the stall roster and fee schedule are seeded local records and reconciliation is a column move, so the portal never renders a waiting state

state_recipes.empty: record every outstanding stall; the outstanding column collapses to its market-reconciled message
state_recipes.validation-error: enter a collected amount that differs from the stall's scheduled fee; an inline mismatch error blocks the record
state_recipes.success: record stall 7 at its scheduled 35; it joins the reconciled column and the tally rises
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the first outstanding stall's record button shows its focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the board at 390x844; the two columns stack with outstanding stalls first

acceptance_facts: The seed lists twenty stalls with a fee schedule of 35 for produce stalls and 50 for prepared-food stalls.
Recording stall 7 moves it from outstanding to reconciled and raises the day tally from 180 to 215.
Reconciliation completes only when the outstanding column reaches zero stalls.

product_signature.mechanism: two-column reconciliation board that drains outstanding stalls into the day tally
product_signature.anchor: day tally counter fixed in the portal header
product_signature.brief_trace: paper slips that blow away before reconciliation
product_signature.counterfactual: a generic spreadsheet grid would fit an inventory brief and never shows what remains outstanding at a glance
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows stall 7 in the reconciled column with the tally at 215

anti_goals: no payment processing, card readers, or money movement of any kind
no vendor accounts, invoicing, or tax reporting
no map layout or stall placement planning

content_seed.data_notes: twenty invented stalls; five arrive pre-recorded so the seeded tally starts at 180 and stall 7 is the first outstanding produce stall
